decisions.public_summary: Approved Pilot-1 self-pilot roles: study owner/data subject may also be custodian; prediction and outcome-adjudication contexts remain information-separated.
Approved owner-only data use: no third-party participant/private record; private raw material stays outside public Git with bounded retention and withdrawal rights.
Approved population/unit: one consenting study owner and one prospectively locked case/window packet; no replacement case or silent substitution.
Approved claim universe: future_forecast only; complete deterministic EFA/claim child universe from the frozen candidate; no manual cherry-picking or free-text additions.
Approved single candidate arm only; no Legacy-vs-Candidate superiority claim; exact candidate/package/manifest binding is deferred to separate start authorization.
Approved Asia/Taipei window 2026-11-01T00:00:00+08:00 through 2026-12-31T23:59:59+08:00 with lock before start and 72-hour post-window maturity delay.
Approved private adjudication labels SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/INDETERMINATE/OUT_OF_UNIVERSE with predefined evidence priority and no favorable reinterpretation.
Approved blinding: prediction execution cannot access outcomes; outcome collection is prediction-blind; adjudication occurs only after outcome bundle seal, with violations logged.
Approved primary feasibility criterion: end-to-end protocol conformance for the one planned case; hit/support rate is not a Pilot-1 success metric.
Approved fixed stopping: exactly one planned real end-to-end case, no replacement after failed lock, no result-dependent early stopping.
Approved withdrawal/deviation handling: no silent deletion or rewriting; deviations are append-only and material blind/integrity failures may make the pilot non-qualifying.
Approved privacy/publication: public output limited to de-identified process-level governance summary; no n=1 claim/outcome-level or private identifying material is published.
